authoringExclusions.reason: Heading currently inherits the public UI family, while monospace and AriesMorinus symbol stacks stay fixed until font loading, glyph coverage, and export parity are validated.
Shell motion remains internal until a public profile can validate reduced-motion behavior and retained-surface transition timing together.
The legacy UI scale currently affects only the body base font rather than the full component metric system.
These values are measured or supplied by their React layout owners and are not design-profile inputs.

relationalConstraints.description: Section and supporting text must not overtake ordinary, header, or reading text.
Responsive frame strokes grow monotonically with the canvas bucket.
Responsive curve strokes do not become thinner on larger canvases.
The station tick clamp has a valid minimum and maximum.
The event glyph clamp has a valid minimum and maximum.
A standard row fits its font plus top and bottom cell padding.
A standard header fits its font plus top and bottom cell padding.
Corner-radius steps remain ordered around the public base radius.
